notes.title: [Patch 1.06] Glasshouse: Concept Demo
notes.notes:
Hello flatmates,

We've released a patch that corrects many of the previously reported problems related to the Concept Demo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43329820/e4c90bfc077644177c4269ec6f7b76849d3cc441.png

Here's the changelog for Patch 1.06: 


     21:9 resolution is now supported
     New "Controls Screen"
     Updated Director's portrait
     Updated CDB Vassal's portrait
     Lighting improvement on Death Ending
     Fixed missing "shot" SFX in the Showdown Scene
     Various ENG translation fixes
     Minor UI (inventory related) bug fixes


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43329820/7c70ad045dc5de2fd4e259da244341f32660dcb5.png

Thank you for your time, see you soon!

Giacomo Montagnoli, Creative Director
FLAT28 Collective
